data.title: 阿斯特蕾亚 · 客厅地毯的笨拙热抱
data.description: 客厅柔软的地毯上，大毛衣滑落肩膀。笨拙的天使双手紧紧圈住你的脖子扑倒在你怀里，羽翼激动地扑棱轻颤，双颊泛着滚烫的红晕，急切又甜美地吻住你的唇瓣。
data.location: warm living room carpet beside cozy sofa
data.action: straddling partner on carpet, off-shoulder sweater, wings trembling with excitement, passionate clumsy kiss, blushing furiously
data.lighting: warm amber floor lamp casting cozy domestic shadows
data.mood: clumsy puppy-like passion, overwhelming love, sweet needy embrace
data.promptProse: Straddling partner on a living room carpet with her sweater slipping off, Astraea kisses eagerly with flushed cheeks and trembling angel wings.
data.animaCaption: Astraea kissing partner passionately on the living room rug with trembling wings.
